reason: Episode produced a reusable curation rule for /banding pairs: the agent first excluded IndiHome vs MyRepublic on a literal type match; the user challenged it and the pair was valid. Also established the eligibility, demand, canonical-key, and read-only probe workflow that recurs on each new pair batch.

Episode: title casing on /banding pages was wrong because entity names were slug-derived. Fix was live data rename, then cache flush and curl of titles to verify. Verification step belongs with pair curation because titles are the pair page's SEO surface.

Episode used "bagus mana" Autocomplete suggestions as the concrete demand test for choosing 4 Poco pairs and skipping 2 Apple pairs. Makes the Demand rule operational instead of a bare existence check.

The pair-page meta and related-link rules added in this episode were not reachable from the current trigger, which only covers adding pairs. Broadening the trigger keeps the next meta/link change routed here.
Replaces the older "hide score from meta" rule with the CTR-backed format and documents the related-pair block order. Without it, the next pair-page change reverts to the disproven meta copy.
Folded into seo-curated-landing-pages (pairs section); probe carried in references/pair-selection-probe.md.
